annotations.title: Propose a correction to your card

description: Propose a correction a person at INITE reviews before it shows: field "name" (with name), "pricing" (with pricing: {model, freeTier, startsAt: {amount, currency, per} | null, source: the page it is on}) or "note" (with note, free text to the editors). Our one-line description and verdicts are not editable; set_read_pages is the faster way to a price. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.
